title: UPS: what tracking statuses mean
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. Label Created means UPS has received the shipment details and billing information from the sender, and the status updates once UPS has the shipment moving in its network. Shipped/On the Way means UPS has received the shipment, it is moving through the network and has a scheduled delivery date; long-distance shipments may not be scanned again until the destination hub. An earlier readback the same day rendered only part of the page; this record reflects the fully rendered text. An earlier same-day readback of the separate UPS claim-documents page showed only its introduction; its later full readback is recorded as ups-claim-supporting-documents-2026-10-22.
